evidence.quote: Lenskart is an AI-powered, vertically integrated eyewear technology platform compounding earnings at >50% annually by converting India's massive unorganized optical market into a high-margin recurring subscription ecosystem.
Lenskart is transitioning from an early rollout model into a high-return compounding machine.
Revenue >32% CAGR alongside >50% EBITDA CAGR places it in elite retail/D2C growth percentile.
Lenskart is replicating this disruption at 10x scale through AI-driven site selection (GeoIQ), remote optometry, and fast delivery.
Lenskart's consolidated EBITDA margin (21.3% Post-IndAS / 12.8% Pre-IndAS) is Above Norm, driven by its 69.3% product margin resulting from 100% private-label vertical integration.
Lenskart displays the classic institutional re-rating signature: High Store Expansion (+603 stores) + Rising ROCE (23.1%) + Expanding Operating Cash Flow (₹886.7 Cr).

Lenskart is an institutional-grade omnichannel eyewear platform compounding cash flows at >50% annually by creating market demand through free AI eye testing and 100% vertically integrated automated manufacturing.
